description: Connect ChatGPT to one Conterminal carrier or freight-forwarder workspace and ask read-only questions about container shipments. Search by container, master bill of lading, reference, vessel, terminal, status, hold, hot-load flag, or supported date. Retrieve a curated operational snapshot for a result, including milestones and current operational flags. Conterminal rechecks the signed-in user, OAuth client, workspace membership, and shipment authorization on every call. The connector cannot edit shipments, dispatch drivers, refresh providers, send messages, upload documents, or access another organization.
